name: code-review
description: Deterministic LangGraph review pipelines: provider setup, target selection, a reusable configurable coverage rule and a prompt-rule engine, driven by a settings.ts + rules/ folder you own and commit in your own repository.

scripts.build: yarn ts-check && yarn clean && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && tsx esbuild.config.ts && tsx scripts/prepare-dist.ts
scripts.validate: yarn lint && yarn test && yarn build
scripts.npm-publish: node ../../scripts/assert-publish-version.mjs latest && cd dist && npm publish --tag latest --registry https://registry.npmjs.org/ ${NPM_OTP:+--otp=$NPM_OTP} ${NPM_DRY_RUN:+--dry-run}
scripts.npm-publish:beta: node ../../scripts/assert-publish-version.mjs beta && cd dist && npm publish --tag beta --registry https://registry.npmjs.org/ ${NPM_OTP:+--otp=$NPM_OTP} ${NPM_DRY_RUN:+--dry-run}
